description: Your onboarding checklist: account activation and your team (who has joined, whose invite is pending), billing state, whether filing needs your approval, and for each business of your account (one business's only with business; one it no longer tracks says how to add it back): each review platform (watched, with its profile and its coverage, not connected, or no longer watched) and its next step, the optional evidence integration (one WordPress plugin for Easy Digital Downloads or WooCommerce), the business profile, the ratings RepuTend fetches and screens on each review site (its low-star reviews only), and Attack Mode (active, or suggested after a burst, with its price).

account.description: The account to act for, by its owner's email or the domain of a business it tracks, as list_businesses shows them. Needed only when you're on more than one account's team.

business.description: The business to act on, by its domain (such as example.com), one of those list_businesses shows. Needed only when your accounts track more than one business.

name: onboarding_status
title: Show the setup checklist
